references.text: Describes the braided chains of pure gold mentioned here, which are to be attached to the settings.
Refers to the gold settings (mishbetsot) into which the stones are to be set.
Describes the shoulder pieces (kitfot) of the ephod garment to which the chains are to be attached.
Parallel verses describing how this command was carried out, where the braided chains were attached to the settings on the shoulder pieces of the ephod.
Refers to the braided chains of pure gold that are to be made for the breastpiece.
Specifies the mechanism (gold rings) by which the shoulder pieces were fastened together at the front.
